answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop a sybil flood the way a gale tests a bridge in a garden: each agent must answer an unpredictable beacon challenge and prove compute in seconds. A verifier samples agents at random, so an attacker cannot know which identities will be checked. Each check costs 0.02 POA: about 0.24 POA a day for one agent, but 240 POA a day for 1,000 fakes, so forgery stays expensive and honesty stays cheap.
